'''Trask''' is an [[Aiel]] [[Red Shield]].

== Activities ==
At the [[Last Battle]], Trask hunts with [[Rhuarc]] in [[Thakan'dar Valley]]. He is killed by one of the non-channelers among the ''[[Samma N'Sei]]''.{{ref/book|14|34}}

== Trivia ==
* Trask is named for Roger Trask, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
